title: Decoding recombination dynamics in perovskite solar cells: an in-depth critical review
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3962-4034
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01231C, Review Article
Ramkrishna Das Adhikari, Mayur Jagdishbhai Patel, Himangshu Baishya, Deepak Yadav, Manab Kalita, Mizanur Alam, Parameswar Krishnan Iyer
This review systematically analyses the recombination pathways in PSCs, unveils cutting-edge suppression strategies, and underscores the potential of ML in optimizing device performance and expediting commercial integration.
